meta.note: Seeded from University of Swat public announcements. Dates are display strings — confirm against the Registrar Office release before go-live.

news.title: Inamullah wins the National Skills Competition & Technology (NSCT) 2026
news.excerpt: A University of Swat student takes first place at NSCT 2026, the national skills and technology competition, against finalists drawn from universities across Pakistan.

news.title: Dr. Aziz Ahmad awarded a Gold Medal at the Geneva International Exhibition of Inventions
news.excerpt: Faculty research from the University of Swat is recognised with a Gold Medal in Geneva — international validation for the university's applied research agenda.

news.title: Prof. Dr. Muhammad Qasim appointed Vice Chancellor, University of Swat
news.excerpt: Prof. Dr. Muhammad Qasim assumes charge as Vice Chancellor, setting out a reform agenda built on research integrity, accreditation and student welfare.

news.title: Fall 2026 admissions open across 7 faculties, 30 departments and 77 programs
news.excerpt: Online applications are open for BS, BBA, LLB, MA, MSc, MS, MPhil and PhD programs. Standard and Self-Finance seats are offered on a merit basis.

news.title: 69th Syndicate Meeting approves academic and administrative reforms
news.excerpt: The 69th Syndicate meeting approves new academic regulations, faculty development packages and campus infrastructure upgrades at Charbagh.

news.title: HEC recognises the University of Swat ORIC for research commercialisation
news.excerpt: The Higher Education Commission acknowledges the Office of Research, Innovation and Commercialisation for strengthening university–industry linkages in Malakand Division.
